# OA.1 The cross-section of figure 1 {#data}

Figure 1 of the paper sets pension spending and the Bismarckian–Beveridgean index of the OECD countries against
their population growth and their income inequality. This chapter gives the values behind each marker, the year
each refers to, the sources, and the correlations the paper's introduction describes.

## OA.1.1 Countries, values and sources {#data-countries}

Point at a marker to see which country it is. The table of countries prints every variable the figure draws, with
the year of each value; the table of sources names, for every column, the provider, the dataset and the series,
and when it was retrieved.
